name: Bruce McKenzie
bio:
Bruce McKenzie is a motorsport veteran, known for his no-nonsense approach and deep understanding of karting technology. Hailing from Melbourne, Bruce's passion for racing ignited early. He spent his youth tinkering with engines in his father's garage, eventually leading him to a career in competitive karting. He quickly gained a reputation for his meticulousness and ability to squeeze every last bit of performance out of the machinery.

Bruce joined Sodi Kart Factory fifteen years ago, starting as a senior mechanic and working his way up to Technical Director. His focus is on refining existing designs and processes rather than radical innovation. He is respected for his ability to identify and correct technical flaws quickly, and he is an advocate for the importance of precision and data analysis. Bruce is always willing to share his knowledge and mentor younger engineers, but he expects a high level of commitment and attention to detail from his team.

What sets Bruce apart is his unwavering dedication to the fundamentals. He believes that mastering the basics is crucial for success, and he instills this philosophy in his team. While some might see his methods as old-fashioned, his results speak for themselves, and he's seen as a valuable asset to Sodi Kart Factory.

physical.description: Bruce is a man of medium build with a weathered face that reflects years spent trackside.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Insists on using imperial measurements alongside metric.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
